name: Twins Rhapsody ~Kaedama Ren'ai Kyousoukyoku~
original_name: ツインズラプソディ ～替玉恋愛狂想曲～
source:
One morning main character can't find his school uniform upon waking up, but instead there's his twin sister's uniform. He decides to go to his sister's girls school and aim for pretty girls there. This is the day when siblings start to attend exchanged schools.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天早上，主人公醒来后找不到自己的校服，眼前却放着双胞胎妹妹的制服。他决定穿上这套制服前往妹妹的女子学校，并以那里漂亮的女孩为目标。这一天，兄妹二人开始交换学校上学。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
